label: Probability
shortDescription: A free university probability course: the axioms, conditional probability and Bayes, random variables, discrete and continuous distributions, and stochastic processes.
modulesDescription: Read the probability chapters in order, or jump straight to the distribution you need.
courseDescription: A complete university probability course, free and worked from the axioms. Build the subject from Kolmogorov's three axioms through conditional probability and Bayes' theorem, random variables and their distributions, and on to stochastic processes — with every result proved rather than asserted.
ogDescription: Learn probability from the axioms up: conditional probability, Bayes, random variables, distributions and stochastic processes, with full proofs and practice.

topics.title: Foundations of Probability
topics.description: Sample spaces, the Kolmogorov axioms, counting, conditional probability, independence, and Bayes' theorem.

topics.title: Random Variables and Discrete Distributions
topics.description: Random variables, pmf and cdf, expectation and variance, and the binomial, Poisson, geometric and negative binomial families.

topics.title: Continuous Random Variables
topics.description: Densities, the cdf, the uniform, normal and exponential laws, derived distributions, and the normal approximation.

topics.title: Stochastic Processes and Markov Chains
topics.description: Markov chains, Poisson processes, Brownian motion, and the first steps into time series.
